summary: A Card titled Trending topics that stacks three Checkbox controls in a column with gap="sm", the title aligned with the controls.
use: Settings and filter cards whose content is several inline controls (Checkbox, Switch, TextField) that need vertical spacing.
spec: `<Card title="Trending topics" headingLevel={3} gap="sm" class="stacked">` with `max-width: 320px`
Three `<Checkbox label="Hacker News" />` children: Hacker News, Product Hunt, Lobsters
`gap="sm"` stacks the children in a column with 8px between them; the title shares the checkboxes' left edge
